title: Track Guide Oulton Park International BMW M2 CSR iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: break once I get to the marker here on the left
corners.gear: down to third before I apply the throttle again
corners.line: cut the curb as much as you can
corners.exit: let the car walk out to the left side of the track
corners.mistakes: keep one set of wheels within the white line

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: break just before we get to the little jump in the road
corners.line: take a later Apex here and get all the way up on the curb
corners.mistakes: put too much of the car out there and now it's a track race

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: break a little bit when I get to the road here on the right side of the track
break a little bit when on the right side of the track
corners.line: ease in the throttle to come out mid track
corners.exit: bring the car over to the left side of the track for turn five
corners.mistakes: be too aggressive with the throttle and push it too far out for turn five

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: break when past the tires on the left side
corners.mistakes: be too hard on the throttle causing oversteer

corners.braking: break with an initial hit of about 70% easing off to the first curb
corners.line: get as close as possible to the tires on the left side, then the right side
corners.mistakes: don't drop a wheel into the grass

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: 100 board, 80% brake pressure, ease off to tire wall
corners.line: cut left, get close to tire wall
corners.exit: slowly apply throttle, aim for mid-track

corners.label: T15
corners.line: cut left, get close to curb

corners.braking: Brake at the board on the left, 80% brake pressure, ease off to the curb
corners.line: Hit both apexes, use the inside curb
corners.exit: Ease throttle in, use curb if needed, take shortest route to the line
corners.mistakes: Understeering too far left, missing the corner, being too aggressive on exit

general_tips: be on the left side of the track for turn one
be on the right side of the track for turn three
be all the way on the right side of the track for turn four
be patient when shifting down from third to second
use all of the road going out to the curve on the outside
